svg.text: Optional: the identity gets a Gaia-X compliance credential for its participant (ADR 0021); a provider's connector checks it when an offer requires it (ADR 0022)
2. Reads the participant file and the notary's registration
number credential (VC-JWT); the certificate chain is read
3. Signs gx:LegalPerson and gx:Issuer with the identity
{base}/credentials/gaiax/); wraps the three in a vp+jwt
7. Also resolves the notary's DID; checks
11. Signature; id is the vcid asked for; every digestSRI is
one of the three sent; valid now. Stores the four,
replacing the last run's; serves the three it sent at their
signature; within validFrom and validUntil; the
gx:compliantCredentials, issued and signed by the caller;
no holder binding for these two. Then the constraint, for
1. POST /v1/gaiax/compliance [8091]; also at start without a valid
compliance credential, and at two thirds of its validity
10. GET the service's DID document: its assertionMethod key
14. Caller check as in the negotiation diagram:
17. GET the compliance service's DID document

C4 model, dynamic diagram. Numbers give the order; dashed arrows are answers. {url} is PORTITOR_GAIAX_COMPLIANCE_URL, {base} the URL of our DID document without did.json. STS tokens are left out. Tested against gx-compliance v2.16.0 in test mode only; Gaia-X policies work between Portitor
